---
title: Scholar metadata for a bare YAML bibliography
format: html
google-scholar: true
bibliography: references-bare.yaml
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_author=Alice Smith;"]']
---

The bibliography is a YAML file with a `references:` list and no `---` delimiters, which pandoc accepts for `--bibliography`. Pandoc has no input format that reads such a file, so the Scholar reference tags need it handled explicitly.

This article cites one work [@cited].
